description: All missions of AquaNox 2: content (English briefings, goals, bonus goals and radio messages taken from the game's own files) and construction (measured in the compiled Lua bytecode of the mission scripts). Counterpart to aquanox1_missions.json.

_sources.mission_structure: dat/sty/mission.des -- script path, briefing key, Goal/BonusGoal blocks with EngineID and RewardInventory per mission.
_sources.goal_text: dat/sty/en/mission.loc -- English text for every goal, keyed by EngineID.
_sources.briefings: dat/sty/en/briefing.loc -- English mission NAME, BriefingText and HintText, with //mission: comments mapping each entry to its mission. AUTHORITATIVE.
_sources.radio: dat/sty/en/mtake_<id>.loc -- radio messages in plain text with speaker, wav path and mood.
_sources.technical: the Lua bytecode of the mission scripts, exact word count.
_sources.walkthrough: GameFAQs (limraz v1.5, Xiaopang666 v1.20) and the AquaNox Fandom wiki -- used only to cross-check.
_sources.encoding_note: All .loc files are UTF-16 LE with BOM, the .des files are Latin-1.
_sources.precedence: Where a walkthrough and a game file disagree, the GAME FILE wins.

_counting_note: Numbers under technik.* are constant-pool occurrences, i.e. 'referenced in N functions', not 'N calls'. Lua 4.0 stores strings per function prototype. Useful as a RELATIVE measure of how much weight a mechanism carries, not as a call count.

patterns._intro: How an AquaNox 2 mission is built, measured across all 33 campaign missions.
patterns.mission_types: Three types, encoded in the id: H = main mission (24), N = side mission (6), B = bonus mission (3). AquaNox 1 has only H and N.
patterns.goal_system: *** THE BIG DIFFERENCE TO AQUANOX 1 *** AN2 has a formal objective system: 48 goals and 33 BONUS goals across 33 missions, each with an EngineID, an English display text and a RewardInventory naming the exact items granted. AquaNox 1 has nothing comparable -- there the briefing text is the only statement of what to do, and there is no reward mechanism. This is the most reusable idea from AN2 for a custom campaign.
patterns.ai_backbone: Unchanged from AquaNox 1: GuardArea and ComplexGoto carry the game. The behaviour library API is the same, which is why AquaNox 1 knowledge transfers directly.

missions.briefing_en:
Task:
Answer Hank Bellows's distress call.
Follow the Nav Points.
Navigate through the canyon.
missions.summary_en: Tutorial. Answer Hank Bellows's distress call, follow the nav points through a canyon and return to the freighter. Teaches movement and navigation; almost no opposition.

takes.text: S.O.S.! Hey, we're in really deep shit here!
Hurry up, man! The hull is breaking up!
Yee-haa! You fell for it, landlubber! Now I'm gonna getcha!
I think I've had a little too much to drink. Maybe I better shove off....
...Freighter of... Drake Enterprises... seems to be empty....
Nat said... go for this Freighter!
I can't believe it... It's been abandoned... too good to be true.
Shut your...! ...dock onto the Freighter...
Aye, Skipper! ... working on it!
Oh...shit! ...hangars... open. Kid's stuff!
Hurry up and get in here! We've got a new home!

missions.briefing_en:
Task:
Take out the NeoYuppies near Lima II.
Follow Amitab's radioed instructions.

Tactical Hint:
Stoney Fox and May Ling will watch your back!
missions.hint_en:
Tip:
Lima II was evacuated a few hours ago. Keep your eyes open and you might find some useful items!
missions.summary_en: First combat mission. Clear NeoYuppie raiders from three nav points near the evacuated station Lima II, with Stoney Fox and May Ling as wingmen. The abandoned station hides lootable items.

takes.text: I've uploaded the data for the next Nav Point near Lima II. Get there as fast as you can.
Damn! Two terror-freaks! Stoney, MayDay - you two hang back. I want to see if shorty's got what it takes!
Confirmed!
Aw, and I really wanted to blow my tubes dry, Skipper!
Okay now.... Show us what you got, little dragon!
Natural, man! That hit the bull's-eye! Keep it goin'!
Off you go to the next Nav Point now. Maybe you can find something there for our little cadet to play with. He's warming up!
Get going, Mate. Turn that Scout into scrap!
Shit - you're turning into a real monster!
William, you fight like an old man pees. You can do better than that!
You guys shut up and head for the next Nav Point!
These guys are killers, so show us what you got! Do them in!
Hey, Skipper... maybe that's one too many for our little fish!
No! Let him go it alone! He's gonna sink or swim!
I don't know... William's such a sweetie, I think we should help him.
MayDay's right - he's not gonna make it! I'm gonna hold his hand!
You're not the only one with an itchy trigger finger! I need some action!
Hey, I told you two...! Aw, hell - have fun!
Okay, knock it off! That's enough for now!
Good job! Those fish are filleted!
I just detected a Bomber close to your position, and it's loaded with torpedoes! Whoever sends it to the bottom gets to keep a bunch of 'em!
Well done, boy. We'll split up the swag later, but that's good booty!
No way! This is my Bomber. Willy's too slow...!
Wooo! Stoney Fox is gonna be your freakin' mortician. Yee-haa!
See that scrappy little Freighter, boy? You chase off those pirates and I'll be able to salvage its cargo. Lots of good items aboard!
Well done, Whackin' Willy! I'll salvage the ship soon!
Touch and go, Drake! I'll be right back!

missions.briefing_en:
Task:
Dr. Finch is being attacked by Crawlers and can't last much longer!
Free Dr. Finch and escort her back to the Harvester!

Tactical Hint:
A Vendetta Sniper is perfect for eliminating poorly-armored targets at long range. Aim for the cockpit!
missions.summary_en: Dr. Finch is pinned down by Crawlers and cannot hold out. Free her and escort her back to the Harvester. Introduces the Vendetta sniper and cockpit-aimed shots. Four bonus objectives.

takes.text: Hurry up! Full tilt! Don't let the Doc get hurt!
Hang on, Dr. Finch! We'll get you out of there - as long as you've got a Credit or two for our trouble!
You'll get your Credits! Now help me fight these damn cannibals!
My on-board computer has calculated an escape route. If we take it, the Crawlers should lose our trail!
I don't know, Doc... Looks like a detour to me.
It is, but it's a safer route!
All right, Dr. Finch. You lead and we'll follow!
I've got something on my scanner....
That's for you, Mate. Check out the next Nav Point.
Looks like it was a false alarm. Come back and join up, Mate!
I'm getting more signals on my scanner. Drake, follow the Nav Point on your computer!
Aw, it's nothing but a few blubberheads! That's none of our business - come on back!
Hey, I've got something really big on my scanner!
I confirm! Take a closer look, William!
Nothing again, Mate. Just an ordinary merchantman. Come back and join up!
We're going through that canyon, so follow me and watch yourselves!
All right, everybody get ready to escort the doctor!
There's a large basin here... and I'm getting some strange echoes. Check out the next Nav Point.
Sharkshit! Just some plants and electromagnetic interference. Return to your position, William!
I've got something on my screen. Have a look in those side canyons!
Okay, looks like it's just an old, deserted habitat. Regroup, William. ...Oh, damn. You're gonna have to find another way back!
Looks like a pirate's nest! Angelina and me'll stay with Doc Finch. Willy - you take out the defenses.
They've got snipers, William! You can't see them on sonar, so keep an eye out and be careful!
Looks good. Rejoin the Harvester, Mate!
Sharkshit! Crawlers - and lots of them!
I'm sending Animal out for backup!
I'm trying to reach the dock! I need an escort!
Watch out, William - snipers! Try to sneak past them!
That was close. Thank you!
There, you see! We're with Dr. Finch!
I'm under fire! My armor is down to 75%!
Armor is down to 50%! I need help!
Armor at 25%! Get over here or I'm not going to make it!
Dr. Finch is dead... You're no use to us, Drake. Hell - I'll bet you don't even know how to swim!
I'm proud of you guys! Come back to the Harvester.
Good thinking, Mate! They could have been a threat to us.
Well done. The pirates are gone, and there's a reward in it for you!
All right, you finished off the Crawlers! Finch owes us a fat reward for that one - and you'll get your share, William.
Good idea. These things might come in handy!!!

missions.briefing_en:
Task:
Escort the Eerie to rescue Stoney Fox.
Continue escorting the Eerie on to Atacama City.

Tactical Hint:
The cockpits of Tornado Zone ships are poorly armored!
missions.hint_en:
Tip:
The Eerie has only a poorly maneuverable turret, making her almost defenseless!
missions.summary_en: Escort the freighter Eerie to pick up Stoney Fox, then on to Atacama City. The Eerie has only a slow turret and is nearly defenceless.

takes.text: I traced the location of Stoney's last E.L.F. message and set a Nav Point there!
Little dragon, this is MayDay in the Eerie! It's only a TechBomber! We need cover!
Hey, Angelina - William: we're here. You two cover us and we'll get Stoney out!
A bunch of Tornado Zone vessels are headed our way!
Hey - do not lose the Eerie! And stay away from those Frigates! Cingan is unpredictable!
Hey, you chickens trying to get your Fox? Well he belongs to me - Cingan - and I'm personally going to send your butts to the bottom with my Daggerboard!
We're not leaving anybody behind! Hurry, May Ling!
Don't... worry. Count us in. We'll... be right there!
He's getting closer. You won't stand a chance against the Daggerboard, so just get Stoney out of there, and make it fast!
Hang on...! We'll get him... Just a couple more minutes.... Hold on!
Good job, William! Now make for A-City as fast as you can!
Hey! I can't leave without my Foxy Blue! I need that ship!!! I'm taking the helm of the Eerie...!
Stoney, you rotten.... All right: without your ship you'd be even more worthless! William, help him out!
I'll try to lure some of those Zoners towards Atacama. Good luck, William!
Just remember: grab the ship, then shove off! No freelancing other targets!
I'm going to dock and grab my boat. Wait for us, William!
Yee-haa! That's for you bums!
Uh-oh! I think I may have accidentally left a plasmabomb in there!
Now head back to A-City, and let me make this clear: nobody steps out of line!
Woo-hoo - Crawlers! What do they want here? Come on, Drake, let's let 'em have it!
You kippers! I told you two.... Drake, see to it that Stoney doesn't have to swim home! MayDay, you head for Atacama City!
Drake, you're a real pal. Let's move!
Watch out for the snipers, William! They've got their engines shut down, so you might not be able to lock on!
We're under fire. Armor at 75%!
My armor is half gone! Come on!!!
Armor's at 25%! This bucket of bolts is going to split in half any minute now!
I owe you, man. How about I let you paint my boat!

missions.briefing_en:
Task:
Get hold of a new boat.
Some freaks trying to hide at Scavenger have three interesting ships.

Tactical Hint:
EMPactor should be equipped!
Use FlashSharks against strong EMP shields!
missions.summary_en: Acquire a better boat: three interesting ships are hidden at Scavenger. Paralyse rather than destroy them -- EMPactor and FlashSharks required.

takes.text: Shove off, Mate. We'll see if we can find something for you!
Wait here. The first ship's gonna pass by any minute. If you're lucky, you'll be able to fire a torpedo before the enemy locks onto you!
Remember what I taught you: only use EMP!
Shit! Wrong switch....
That moron accidentally jettisoned his escape pod! Pity to waste a nice Avenger, but I've already located another ship!
Look at that Avenger - isn't she sweet?! Go for it!!!
It's just a Toiler, but that's better than nothing!
Now that little ship is ours! Hey... I see something else out there!
Well, that's a nice lady, too, huh?
You must be out of your god damn mind! You can't operate that close to Scavenger. Atahualpa Jones'll get mad as hell!
That's your new ship, Mate - the Mighty Maggie. Good job!
You're not supposed to sink her, you're supposed to paralyze her!
Remember - don't let that ship get too close to Scavenger. That station is off limits for us!

missions.briefing_en:
Task:
Atahualpa Jones's man, Goons, has been captured by the Intrepido.
Find Goons, free him and return him to Atacama City.

Tactical Hint:
The Intrepido use boats similar to the light Scouts of the Atlantic Federation!
missions.summary_en: Side job for Atahualpa Jones: his man Goons has been captured by the Intrepido. Find him, free him and bring him to Atacama City. The Intrepido fly boats similar to Atlantic light scouts.

takes.text: Okay, guys. Let's truss this bum into a nice little package!
Cool, man - I'm Goons. So Jones didn't let me down after all.... Let's clear off through these canyons, then I'll wait for you at the Nav Point!
There are mines all over the place - and I don't have any weapons! With this hold full of... uh... medicine, I'm not gonna be real maneuverable, so you need to clear the mines!
Man, you're deep-ocean cool! I'll tell Jones you piss ice cubes! Thanks!
Hey... shit! My armor's down to 75%!
Damn... do something! My armor's down to 50%!
Armor down to 25%! I'm almost dead, man!
Man, you're really clever! Great idea covering our tracks like that... and worth a bonus!
Warning! This is a prison transport! Keep your distance!

missions.briefing_en:
Task:
Stop two Freighters on their way to Brainfire.
Guard the Eerie when it docks to loot them.

Tactical Hint:
In case Brainfire sends reinforcements, add a powerful kinetic weapon in addition to the EMPactor on your ship.
missions.hint_en:
Tip:
The two Freighters must not get within range of the Atlantic Frigates near Brainfire!
missions.summary_en: Side job: stop two freighters bound for Brainfire and guard the Eerie while she docks to loot them -- without letting the freighters reach the Atlantic frigates near Brainfire.

takes.text: Head for the Nav Point. You need to paralyze the Freighters before they get in range of those Brainfire Frigates!
That's important, William. If you don't, I can't dock on to salvage anything!
The Transports are 1,500 meters from Brainfire!
Only 1,000 meters from Brainfire!
Only 750 meters from Brainfire. Hurry up!
Got it! I'm on my way to the first Freighter!
I'm docking onto Freighter number 1 now!
I got everything I could get here. Heading for the second Freighter!
I'm finished. Let's go, William!
The Freighters! Paralyze them, William!
We blew it! The Freighters are in Brainfire's firing range!
You blew it, Drake! One of the Freighters was destroyed!
Well, that's that! Without Angelina we might as well do ourselves in!
Angelina, you can dock now. The Freighters are paralyzed. Drake, give her cover!
Well done, marineros!
I've only got 75% armor left, William!
This is going to be close! I'm down to 50% armor!
25% armor, William! Don't let me drown!
Okay, I'm finished. Let's shove off!
Be careful! Keep your distance!

missions.briefing_en:
Task:
Stoney Fox challenges you to a race!
The winner can expect a fine reward!

Tactical Hint:
Only the Salty Dog stands a chance against Stoney's ship!
Kinetic weapons are against the rules!
EMP weapons, however, may prove useful!
missions.hint_en:
Tip:
EMP weapons can slow Stoney for a short time!
But be careful: Stoney knows that trick too!
missions.summary_en: Bonus mission. Stoney Fox challenges the player to a race. Kinetic weapons are against the rules, EMP weapons are not -- and Stoney knows that trick too. Only the Salty Dog can keep up.

takes.text: Okay, sport: The one who finishes first wins!
Three....
Two....
Go!
What's the problem? You changing your oil?
Hey, stumble bum! Can't you do any better than that???
Woo-hoo...! You still alive, sleepyhead?
Sharkshit! That damn - you won, you show-off!
Yee-ha! Stoney the Fox is faster than his reputation! I win!
You really think you can win with a ship like that? Forget it!

missions.briefing_en:
Task:
Escort Dr. Finch to the Machina Antarctica outpost.
Finch must arrive unharmed!

Tactical Hint:
The seas around Cape Horn are swarming with pirates, but they're poorly armored!
missions.summary_en: Escort Dr. Finch to the Machina Antarctica outpost; she must arrive unharmed. The waters around Cape Horn swarm with lightly armoured pirates. Sparing Hank Bellows is a bonus objective.

takes.text: Get Dr. Finch home safe and sound!
Hey, Skipper - you can count on us!
Holy test tube! I hope that clam-brain doesn't get us into trouble!
Don't worry, Doc - Drake is cool!
I wasn't talking about Drake, you-
Snipers! It's an ambush!
Cut those snipers down, Drake!
Hey, mateys, it's that dried mackerel Dr. Finch! Dr. Swedenborg sends his best regards!
Swedenborg - that thief! And he's beefed up his ships! Let him have it!!!
Woo, William... we have to be more careful than that!
What's going on, Finch?! Who the hell is this Swedenborg?!
A very ambitious colleague! He wants the superweapon I developed all to himself! He's trying to cut me out of the picture completely!
Lady, I don't give a damn about your academic infighting!
But you're supposed to protect me! My armor...!
You two bums! I'm not paying you to be shot to pieces by those gangsters!
If I don't get some protection right now I've had it!
Great! Nice going, you two morons! Finch is dead, and you may get to join her!
So, Ship's Mate Drake. Seems as if you were quite useful!
Don't... don't kill me, boy! I...I might come in handy one day! Don't do anything you'll regret!
You're a helluva guy! I owe you one! See you around!

missions.briefing_en:
Task:
An old foe named Chow Lung has finally tracked down Amitab and May Ling.
He is massing an attack against the Harvester, which must be defended!

Tactical Hint:
Enemy fire is already reaching the dock, so be careful when putting to sea!
missions.hint_en:
Tip:
Amitab's hatred of his former rival means Chow Lung's mortician can expect a special reward!
missions.summary_en: Chow Lung has tracked down Amitab and May Ling and masses an attack on the Harvester. Enemy fire already reaches the dock, so undocking itself is dangerous.

takes.text: Do those bums in! Now!
Shogunate men.... I like them well-done! Let's go!
William, we've almost made it!
Well done, Mate. I'm sure those Techno-screwballs will be glad to reward you for saving their high-pressure tanks!
Hao! Hao! Is there a little blind child at the helm!
Hey, Amitab! You must be using bilgerats for pilots!
Bu hao! I haven't seen sissies this sissy for a long time!
...everything's burning here... Too late...!
Way hey! They're not gonna bother us anymore!
Woo-hoo! One less moron!
That's better than sex! I deserve a bonus!
Seems as if you can start passing out the bonuses, Skipper!
You're comin' on, Mate. A real killer! I'll keep my promise!
Yeah! More... more.... I'm just getting started!
They're attacking our tritium high-pressure tanks on the other side!
I've located Chow Lung. I owe a big one to whoever blows his butt off!
There must be a pirate's nest somewhere! They're attacking the outpost... Now let's hope they don't mess with us!
Your job is to cover the Harvester! That Machina outpost isn't our concern!
Keep it up! They've almost had it!
Watch out! There are more pirates behind the Harvester! Take 'em out!
Whew... we seem to have weathered that second wave....
Hey, Mate! That Machina lady just sent you a Credit upload. Seems somebody likes your heroic style!

missions.briefing_en:
Task:
Swedenborg has stolen Dr. Finch's research project: a new weapon.
Amitab wants the weapon recovered!
Follow Swedenborg and paralyze his ship, but don't destroy it!

Tactical Hint: Take an EMPactor along!
missions.hint_en:
Tip:
Swedenborg's men are poorly paid and unmotivated mercenaries!
If anything happens to their client, they'll give up the fight!
missions.summary_en: Swedenborg has stolen Dr. Finch's weapon research. Pursue and PARALYSE his ship without destroying it. His mercenaries are badly paid and break off once their client is hit.

takes.text: Head for the next Nav Point! There's a bunch of pirates there!
Stop that hothead! You're fighting on my Credits!
Beware, Mate! Don't just rush them blindly!
He's not here! Get out of there - they're too strong! Move on to the next Nav Point!
There's that rat Swedenborg, farting his way through the ocean! Track him down, Drake!
My men are in tip-top shape, and they're gonna take you out!
Paralyze him! His cargo is worth a bucket of Credits!
Why don't you finish that frogspawn off?
Hello? Swedenborg here! Hey... don't kill me! Please, don't kill me!
You loser! When Swedenborg went to the bottom, so did our pay!
Well done, Mate! Head for home. We'll savage what we can!
You're a real monster, Drake! You'll get a reward for this!

missions.briefing_en:
Task:
Raid Captain Redbeard's hidden camp.
Appproach through the canyon.
Take out any defenses.
missions.summary_en: Bonus mission. Raid Captain Redbeard's hidden camp, approaching through a canyon, and take out the defences.

missions.briefing_en:
Task:
The Harvester is under fire.
The attackers have not been identified.
Defend immediately and destroy the attackers!
missions.summary_en: The Harvester is under fire from unidentified attackers. Immediate defence; the shortest mission of the game at 87 KB.

takes.text: By Typhoeus's waterlogged ass - who are those morays, and what do they want?
Don't know, but I wish they'd send their greetings by mail!
Who cares who they are? In a few minutes we can talk about who they were!
Damn! That'd even make the Devil blow his top!
William, there's still one of them hanging around your Nav Point. Show him the way to the bottom!
Come on and I'll wrap your neck around your ankles!
Aw... are you scared? Good - 'cause I'm gonna have you for breakfast!
We're all gonna die...! Fire...!
Well done, Mate. I think you're growing teeth!
Phew! Looks like we cleaned up on that buffet! Still, stay on patrol till we're sure it's clear!
Aha! I've located a cargo route in the area, Mate!
There, you see?! You're becoming a real fireball!

missions.briefing_en:
Task:
Meet a military convoy at first Nav Point.
Escort the convoy through the area.
Follow Amitab's orders.
missions.summary_en: Meet a military convoy at the first nav point and escort it through the area under Amitab's orders.

takes.text: Marineros! Those ships may look wild, but the pilots are only rusty civilians! We're to escort them to the Asylum!
Aye, Skipper. Babysitter one is on the way!
I don't mind. Whoever comes along can eat my torpedoes!
Aye, aye, Skipper! MayDay is on guard, dutifully polishing her fingernails!
There's something at the Nav Point. Check it out, Drake!
Damn... another false alarm....
There's something at that Nav Point again. Take a look!
Bloody hell.... Just some harmless blubberheads. Let them go!
Uh-oh... now I'm getting Crawler readings at the Nav Point! Check it out!
Weird.... a neutralized Crawler Scout, but no pilot.... What are they up to?
Looks good, boy! I'll salvage it later, because a Crawler Scout may be just what we need!
Hey - are you crazy, man?! We're gonna crash! Get out of my way!
There's too many of 'em! I'm in deep shit here!!!
Danger stinks, folks, and I smell something really nasty here....
Oh my god! It's an... ambush, or-
I knew it.... All right....
Beware, Drake - there are snipers all over the place. Freaking snipers!
You braindead bastards - you blew it!
Hey - we made it! Thank you very much! We'll be all right from here on out.
I could smell it! Those two idiots have some useful stuff on board!
Whas' tha'...? hic! Are they - hic! - attacking a pirate?
Hey, Billyboy... hic! - I need t' pee! Hahahaha...! An' I'm aimin' at your tail fin!
Okay, William. I'll salvage the cargo off the Freighter as soon as I can.

missions.briefing_en:
Task:
An attack by Leo van der Waal's men is expected.
Patrol near El Topo's Asylum with May Ling.
Follow any radio instructions.

Tactical Hint:
The EnTrOx ships are heavily armored!
missions.summary_en: Patrol near El Topo's Asylum with May Ling against an expected attack by Leo van der Waal's men. The EnTrOx ships are heavily armoured.

takes.text: You two check the surrounding area - and no fooling around!
Aye - you bet I'm checking it out....!
Just follow the Nav Points.
That's so boring... like every film from the Shogunate!
MayDay, concentrate on your job! This area's dangerous!
Okay, Xiao Long! I know you made your choice... but nobody chooses against May Ling and lives to talk about it!
Drake, you provoked her! Big mistake! MayDay, cut that out!
Defend yourself, William! I warned you! She's gonna cut you into cubes!
Listen you two bilgerats, stop that at once!
You're gonna have to live with the fact that you rejected me - for the next two minutes! 'Cause that's all the time you have left!
Contact! Stop that! Leo van der Waal's EnTrOx drones are attacking! William, you've got to stop them! I'll send backup!
Kiss my ass! You're nothing but a bunch of screwball cowards! I'm out of here!
Okay, William - I'm with you. Now concentrate, man!
Forget May Ling - this is about survival!
Yeah! We've got 'em!
Watch out, William - someone's firing at a Helinox tank! Put a stop to that!
Damn... pull in your flippers! The Asylum's taking heavy damage, Drake!
Things don't look good, Mate! You keep on like that and the Asylum's history!
That's it - the Asylum's been destroyed. Boy, did we blow it!
What a mess! I don't know who's gonna pay for that, but it's sure not gonna be us!

missions.briefing_en:
Task:
Hell's Vortex is waiting for you.
Scout the abyss.
missions.summary_en: Scout the abyss called Hell's Vortex and destroy the Biont waiting there -- the alien thread of the story surfaces.

takes.text: William, you can do it. You will have worse tasks in life than this.
Watch out, William!
You've got to go down there. Nobody can do it for you. Now go!
Stay calm, William. We've got you on our scanners.
Be ready for currents. Deep-sea trenches are unpredictable!
I'm getting some strange signals here.... We should order him back, Nat.
No! William, there's no other choice!
William, where are you? Can you hear me?
William! On the valley floor... Watch out for magma!!!
I... there is something... big. Watch out, William!
You almost... your target.... Face your destiny!
He... disappeared off my screen! William! Oh my god....
...Go on, boy... it's waiting for you. You've got to be strong...
...You made it, boy!
William! You made it! I'm so... happy!
Come back now, my friend. Come back aboard!

missions.name_en: To be or not to be...
missions.briefing_en:
Task:
The Harvester is being attacked with EMP weapons by Lt. Hamlet and two other mercenaries.
Leave immediately and protect the Harvester.
Destroy Lt. Hamlet.

Tactical Hint:
The enemies are well equipped!
missions.hint_en:
Tip:
The enemy has deployed elite pilots!
Tactics can save the day!
missions.summary_en: Lt. Hamlet and two mercenaries attack the Harvester with EMP weapons. Destroy Hamlet and stop the bombs. Elite pilots; taking Hamlet out first is a bonus objective.

takes.text: Sharkshit! With the Harvester running on emergency power we can't open the dock gates! You're on your own!
Hey, William! Looks like you've had your last Tsunami Booster! Now eat my torpedoes!
You drunk again? Maybe I'll blow myself up for you, you loser! Show me what you've got - I'll bet a seaslug's quicker!
Hey, Crimson.... What kind of name is that, anyway? I'll bet you got it because you're always red-faced with shame, you washout!
Stay cool, William, and let this freshwater boozer have it!
So, the little boy gets to play, huh?
Hey, man, where do you get off?! That hurt - and you're gonna pay for it!
Hey... Crimson! We're... old friends! Stay cool!
Finish them all off, Crimson!
Get going! Armor's down to 50%!
Armor's down to 25%! Be quick now, Willy!
Oh, we've had.... ...lost... Daaaaamn!
You put up a brave fight, Crimson! Now just hang on while we fix the docks!
I owe you, Mate! I was getting pretty sick of that bum's babbling!
Check the new Nav Point! Something's wrong!
Damn! It's those bums again... This thing's headed right for the Harvester! Drake, take it out!
Well, done, Mate! You're almost there! Sharkshit! There are two more coming in - get after them!
Damn. Those things are swimming bombs! They've hit the Harvester, but we're holding on. William, you've got to stop them! They're priority one!
We almost had it! Well done, boy! And Fuzzy says the docks are powered up again!
God Almighty - what's that?! ...I've got a bad feeling. Stay ready, Mate!
Damn! There are two more bombs behind us! You've got to stop them, Crimson!

missions.briefing_en:
Task:
Pirates are attacking El Topo's already weakened defenses.
Destroying the pirates will produce a good many Credits.
missions.hint_en:
Tip:
Pirates use command vessels to coordinate their forces!
missions.summary_en: Side job. Pirates attack El Topo's already weakened defences. They coordinate through command vessels -- killing those first breaks the attack. Sparing Redbeard is a bonus objective.

takes.text: Freaking pirate parasites! They're taking advantage of the situation!
We're helping an old friend. El Topo wants the waters around him cleaned up, so do your best!
Those Freighters look like they're command vessels!
You're almost there!
You better not mess with Amitab and his crew! We sunk their sorry asses!
Yee-haa... some of them are choking on water! They're clearing off!
Looks good, boy! I'm sure I'll find some more nice stuff for you here!
Redbeard is gonna kill all of you, and nobody's gonna find your graves!

missions.briefing_en:
Task:
Attack an outpost of the Atlantic Federation.
Escort the Eerie to the remote hangar and cover her while she docks.

Tactical Hint:
Expect plenty of ground units and turrets when you arrive!
missions.summary_en: The largest side job: attack an Atlantic Federation outpost, escort the Eerie to the remote hangar and cover her while she docks and empties the stores. Heavy ground units and turrets.

takes.text: Stoney's going to dock at an Atlantic Federation hangar near the Nav Point and steal a Buggy. We need that Buggy pronto!
Stoney's having trouble with the Eerie! William, slip in there and clear away all those Atlantic Federation defenses!
You're a born custodian, William! All right... docking now!
Woo-hoo! This is so much fun! Yee-haa!
Hey, there are some bums behind us! Let's do 'em in and make for the outpost!
I got one of their vehicles! I can slip in without being noticed, so stay back until I've neutralized the turret controls!
Woo-hoo! The turrets are dead! Hey William, come and get these two Scouts off my butt, okay?!
Okay so far.... Stoney, you head back to the Eerie. William, give him cover!
I just gotta get rid of that stupid Buggy. I'll be right back...!
Okay, I'm back. Now off to the outpost!
Negative! It's still too dangerous in there for the Eerie! William, get in there and clean the place up!
Touch and go, Drake! I come in, I dock, I clear out the storeroom, then we shove off!
The Atlanters are sending out some Scouts, William! Protect the Eerie!
Well done, boys! Come on back!
The Eerie's armor is down to 75%!
Armor's down to 50%! Hurry up, man!
Get a move-on, Drake! I'm down to 25% armor!!!
Hey... my tank's only got 75% armor left! I need cover!
Shit! Only 50% armor! Freakin' worthless Buggy!
25% armor, Drake! I've almost had it!
Damn, that's it! Without the Eerie we're finished!
Damn! The freaking Buggy's destroyed!
Good thinking! We can always use more equipment.
Well done, Mate. I'll bet El Topo's gonna fork out plenty of Credits for protecting this ELF-node.

missions.briefing_en:
Task:
Freeman isn't used to his new ship yet, so he needs to be escorted to the EnTroPoint.
missions.summary_en: Short side job: escort Freeman, who is not yet used to his new ship, to the EnTroPoint.

takes.text: Freeman is waiting for you at the Nav Point, William!
Where'd that guy get to? And what's he up to?
Oh... I just can't... control this... stupid boat!
Looky here: he's got the brain of a clam!
Hello! I... I need to get to the next EnTroPoint as fast as possible.... I made a little mistake recently....
Boy, oh boy... I just want to go home....
Wow, this guy's a first-class idiot, you know?
...And then I said to Pitty: 'Don't knock it all back at once, man! That stuff will give your mouth a rash!'
If you weren't his escort you could just blow that gasbag off!
...Well, over at Scavenger I had three geishas at the same time, and I said to Pitty: 'Can you lend me your-'
Okay, Freeman! You're history! You stole Emerald Flint's ship and I'm gonna kill you for that!
Huh?! What do you want, blowhard!?
I'm the blowhard who's gonna blow your guts out your ass!
God Almighty! Are all the loonies out today? William, protect your loony from the others!
Neopolis kids, high on chem! Get a life!
Escort that blockhead to the EnTroPoint! He'd get lost going to the bathroom!
Hey, he's firing at me!
Hey...! What am I paying you for?!?!
Aaah... I've almost had it!
You blew it, man! What were you thinking?
Thanks, buddy. I probably would have managed without you, but still....
Well, at least he didn't hit his head on the dock.... Thank god that's over.
Look what we've got here...! An unmanned Freighter! I'll bet there are some useful gadgets on board!
Oh - you're the help we need! We just fought some Crawlers in the canyons back there, and now one of our men is missing.
We need to hold position here. If you can find him for us, the Atlantic Federation won't be stingy!
Thank Typhoeus! My weapons systems are offline, and I couldn't have lasted much longer. Could you ferry me back to my unit?
Thank you very much! I'll make sure your Credits are uploaded!
God Almighty! Are all the loonies out today?
Shut up!

missions.briefing_en:
Task:
Crawlers are attacking the Harvester.
Angelina and her ship have been captured.
Free Angelina.

Tactical Hint:
A Crawler Scout would be useful!
missions.hint_en:
Tip:
A frontal assault won't be very successful!
Cleverness is called for!
missions.summary_en: Crawlers attack the Harvester and capture Angelina and her ship. A frontal assault fails -- destroy the energy supply first, then free Angelina.

takes.text: You two boys make sure Angelina gets back here safe and sound!
Crawlers are just like everybody else in Aqua: they look to kill before they get killed themselves!
Yeah, but they're the only ones who turn their victims into kebabs!
Quiet, Skipper - they're close!
It's your job now, Drake. I'm waiting for you and Angelina to return!
At your Nav Point you'll find the energy supply for the station. Cut the power, but watch out for snipers!
Excellent - you got the juice turned off! And I've located Angelina's bioprint in a bunker on the wall!
You made it, William.... The dock's clear, the floodgates are open! Wait for me - I'll be there in a moment!
Okay, you two! Shove off, now! Animal is on his way to meet you!
Try to get to the Harvester - as fast as you can!
Stealth must not be your specialty, Drake, because you're making a hell of a lot of noise! Boy, we sure could've used a Crawler Scout!
Take care, William!
You've been discovered! So, hey - have some fun!
Angelina is dead! All is lost...!
Dock immediately! Come on!
Hey, Crimson! You're our hero!
I'm with you, William!
My generator's running at half power and my weapons are jammed! Help me, William!
Hey, wake up, Mate! Those are Crawler Tanks!
William! You watching a data channel? There are Crawler Scouts swarming around!
Let's just hope they don't discover the Harvester!

missions.briefing_en:
Task:
Discover the location of Juan Garcia Lopez's treasure.
missions.hint_en:
Tip:
Watch out for traps and other devices that need to be taken out!
missions.summary_en: Locate Juan Garcia Lopez's treasure. Traps and devices guard the site and must be taken out.

takes.text: Crimson, Mate! Let's go treasure hunting! Head for the volcano!
That was a flop... but have a look at that freaking volcanic lake!
Strange... on Gillmore's map everything is just like this.... Hmm....
Ah-ha! There's a canyon to the west! Check it out!
That's got to be it! I've marked the Nav Point!
What a great feeling! I can smell the treasure! Get closer, Crimson!
Lopez! That god damn ship's propeller is creating a strong current! You can't approach! We need another plan!
Weapons won't help.... Wait - I've got it! Head back to that volcanic lake!
Look to the north for a small passage. It might get you past the lake!
What are those strange objects over there? Move closer!
There! There's a second canyon to the northwest!
Unless I'm completely wrong... take a look through that hole farther up. You should see that propeller from the side!
Maybe you can take out the turbine!
It's working! Keep firing!
It'll be finished any minute!
Well done, Mate. Come back to the Harvester. We need to figure out what to do next!

missions.briefing_en:
Task:
Escort Amitab to the dock at Garcia's secret hideout.
missions.hint_en:
Tip:
Lopez was famous for his clever traps and devices!
Be careful!
missions.summary_en: Escort Amitab to the dock at Garcia's secret hideout and salvage the treasure. At 627 KB the second-largest mission of the game; Lopez's traps are the theme.

takes.text: Yeah! Lopez, you bastard, we found your treasure! We're rich!
Treasure fever is rising, William! Let's hope the map to the Angel's Tears is in there as well!
Thanks for your escort, Crimson. Wait for me here!
Sharkshit! You've got to take out the turrets!
Okay... looks good. Wait here.
It's a trap! Help me out, Crimson!
That turret looks suspicious. Check it out, but be ready to head for cover!
That turret could heat up hell! Can you see those cables? They must connect it to an energy supply!
Yeah! That must be the energy supply!
This station looks like it was built symmetrically. Check the other side for power cables!
I'm headed into the gorge now!
Laser traps! I can see their energy supplies on my scanner, at the end of the gorge... but I can't get through!
The energy supply is here, on the right side!
Great, Mate! I'm coming to dock! This is going to be a party!
I'm at the dock now, William. Stay on your toes out there!
Geez! Lopez's men built this whole place... so many years ago! Hey... there is something here!!!
I've got to get out of here - the whole place is collapsing!
Faster man, faster - or we've had it!
I... you blew it...! I had it!
Good - turret neutralized!
Okay, William, I'm back! Got everything, and it was better than sex and booze!
That was close! Now back to the Harvester!

missions.briefing_en:
Task:
Order Mercenaries are attacking the Harvester.
Red Alert! Chase off or destroy the attackers.

Tactical Hint:
The Order Mercenaries are well equipped!
missions.hint_en:
Tip:
Warning: Elite pilots!
Being clever counts!
Watch out for bombs!
missions.summary_en: Order Mercenaries attack the Harvester. Red alert -- elite pilots, and bombs that must be destroyed.

takes.text: You have a closer look at that bum there, William. Stoney and me, we'll patrol here!
May the... there's another one!
Help us, Drake! The god damn sea is boiling around us!
That's my gift to you brave treasure hunters!
Animal is with me here now. We're trying to salvage that thing. ...Never know what it might be good for....
Stop him - and I want him alive!
We're paralyzed, brother! I think Nat's badly hurt, but I've only got a few scratches!
Animal... hang on! I'm coming!!!
Kill that fool! Go!
...Crimson... the four things... remember? The fifth is the most important.... Life itself....
Amitab! The skipper sacrificed himself for me.... Great heart!
Crimson! Beware of the bomb!
The Harvester! We... damn, I can't hold her any longer. She's had it!
Come back on board. Damn - we can't take any more victories like that!

missions.briefing_en:
Task:
A new wave of Order Mercenaries are attacking the Harvester.

Tactical Hint:
The Order Mercenaries are well equipped!
missions.hint_en:
Tip:
Warning: Elite pilots!
Being clever counts!
Watch out for bombs!
missions.summary_en: A second wave of Order Mercenaries hits the Harvester. Same structure as 4H4; the chapter's title mission, in which Angelina's role is revealed.

takes.text: We've got to take care of that bomb, William. I don't feel good about this....
Angelina, listen: there's a second bomb coming! You've got to take care of that one. William, you stick with the first one and take it out!
Don't worry about me, Crimson. I'll be all right!
Ah-ha, there's one of 'em left!
It doesn't look good, William! I need your help!
So... it's sweet little Angelina! And I'm going to kill you, sweetheart!
Come on, Strega! I'm not afraid of you!
I see. Are you also not afraid to die?!
Williaaaaaam...!
We'll meet again, William Drake!
Oh, my god! The bomb's reached the Harvester!
Come on back aboard, boy. William... come back!

missions.briefing_en:
Task:
Captain Redbeard killed your mother.
Revenge! Destroy Captain Redbeard!
missions.summary_en: Bonus mission and personal revenge: Captain Redbeard killed the player's mother. Kill him; his accomplices are a bonus.

takes.text: Come here, shorty. Come to Redbeard, and he'll deliver you to your family's tomb!
What now? Are you gonna bore me to death???
I already saw your mother die whimpering. Do me a favor and die like a man!
My old man, he killed his own family. I remember he used to say....
If you want something done right, do it yourself. Lucky he missed me, that rotten boozer!
So that's exactly what I'm gonna do with you. Finish you off personally!
Gotcha...! You went for my trap like a sprat committing suicide!
I'm gonna kill you like I killed your mother! If it's any comfort, she died with her boots on!
You're really lousy, Drake! Not enough experience on the high seas! Pretending to be an adventurer isn't easy, is it?
Damn! Well you still don't have me, sprat butt!
You little bastard!
How...?! I can't believe it!
That's the way my planet spins! Feels good, huh?
You're no match for Redbeard!
Uh-oh.... You choking, shorty?
Listen, at least you're gonna meet your mommy again - in heavenl!

missions.briefing_en:
Task:
Destroy the defenses around Lunat's shipyard.
Guard the Eerie while she docks.
Escort the Deimos and the Eerie to the Neopolis docks.

Tactical Hint:
Expect plenty of ground targets and turrets!
missions.hint_en:
Tip:
A frontal assault would be difficult!
Look for cover!
Cleverness will win the day!
missions.summary_en: Destroy the defences around Lunat's shipyard, guard the Eerie while she docks, then escort the Deimos and the Eerie to the Neopolis docks. Many ground targets and turrets -- cover matters more than firepower.

takes.text: I've got the coordinates of the shipyard. You're our only backup, so stay alert!
That's the shipyard there. If you're clever, you should be able to take out all the defenses in one go. Just make sure they don't see you!
Uh-oh - looks like you woke 'em up. They're looking for you - you'll have to go it alone!
Good job, boy. Come back and escort us to the shipyard!
Be on guard everybody - I'm docking!
Stoney and Animal, go on in - but keep your eyes open! It's too damn quiet....
Lunat's men, and Atlanters! You've got to stop them. Stoney's already got the Deimos, he just needs to shove off. Animal's already on his way back!
Animal's back with me! Stoney should be here with the Deimos any minute!
Yee-haa! This boat's orgasmic!!!
Huh.... I wonder what that guy's looking for at the Museum of the Modern Age? Anyway, good job, William. Come on back.
The Eerie's been hit. Armor at 75%!
Damn - another hit! Armor down to 50%!
Do something, Crimson - we've almost had it!
Shit! Deimos armor 75%!
They're blowing my balls off! My armor's almost gone!
Keep cool, Stoney. Let's get away from here!
There's one of Strega's Order Mercenaries. Follow him, Crimson. See where he's going - but don't get caught!
Do something! The armor on the Deimos is about to fail!

missions.name_en: The Museum of the Modern Age
missions.briefing_en:
Task:
Take out the Museum's defenses by destroying the local energy relay.
Enter the Museum through the maintenance tunnel.
Guard the Eerie when she docks.
Escort the Eerie to the dock of Neopolis.
missions.summary_en: Cut the Museum's defences by destroying the local energy relay, enter through the maintenance tunnel, guard the docking Eerie and escort her to Neopolis. MayDay must be eliminated.

takes.text: Okay, you should see the energy supply at the Nav Point. Paralyze the transformers! We're heading for the maintenance tunnel. See you in a minute, Crimson.
There are more defenses here. You better paralyze them immediately.
Good job. We're waiting for you at the new Nav Point.
Look for the dock gate, Crimson. Should be somewhere in the maintenance tunnel!
Animal and I'll wait for you here. We've got your back, buddy!
What the hell - we've still got an active energy barrier here! Look for another energy supply coming in somewhere!
Shit, man! We got a problem. Someone triggered an alarm!
It's all red fog here, boys! The turrets are being reactivated. They'll do us in!
Fall back! ....Crimson, get the hell out of there! Now!
Like I said, Xiao Long. You made your choice. You didn't want to take your pants off - so now I'm gonna pull them over your head!
I guess there's no way to avoid it, so get it over with! But hurry up, before the Police are swarming around here!
Okay, now dock! Hurry up, Crimson!

missions.briefing_en:
Task:
Rescue Stoney and Animal from Navy Headquarters.
Find a way into the basement and destroy the emergency generator powering the maintenance tunnel.
Guard the Eerie when she docks.

Tactical Hint:
The basement is very tight! Take the Salty Dog!
missions.summary_en: Rescue Stoney and Animal from Navy Headquarters: reach the basement, destroy the emergency generator powering the maintenance tunnel, guard the Eerie. The basement is tight, so the small Salty Dog is required. LARGEST MISSION OF THE GAME at 690 KB of script.

takes.text: I'll wait here while you neutralize the turrets and torpedo launchers so I can dock!
So much for the easy part. We've docked. Fuzzy and I will go in and get Stoney and Animal out! You stand guard, and make sure we're not surprised!
Yee-haa! Who would have thought I'd be so happy to see you bums again?!
Save your breath!
Seems pretty quiet here at the moment.... Somebody must be giving away free booze nearby. No patrols?!?
Booze?! Don't you know there's a putsch on at the Parliament right now?
Wow, tough luck for them - but good for us! I'll bet they withdrew the museum guards, and they'll never expect a second attack so soon!
The entrance to the basement is at the Nav Point, just like the museum attendant said. Remember - take out the security systems!
Yeah! Animal and I'll cover Nat, because his fat ship won't fit through the entrance to the basement!
Remember the sensors and the laser. Be sneaky, and you'll find the damn energy supply in the rear!
Only one generator left, boy! The maintenance tunnel should open up for us when you take it out!
Great, Crimson! Come back now and give us cover!
We're in, and looking for the key now! Your preparations really paid off!
Oh my god! The key isn't here! Somebody beat us to it!!!
Thanks for your cooperation, children. That was easier than stealing a pacifier from a baby!
Strega - she tricked us! Snatched that damn key right out from under our noses! Crimson, Stoney, Animal - don't let her escape!
...Time to leave, Order Mercenaries! Shove off!
We blew it - the key is gone! Damn.... We'll never catch them now...! Break off pursuit!
Willy! How about a Tsunami Booster?
You diseased toad - that hurt! You're killing me!
You bum! Hey... you're killing me! That... hey!
I've had it! The bastard's hit me!
Great shot, Crimson. Strega needs every man now, and we just got rid of one!
We've got a job to do back at the museum!

missions.briefing_en:
Task:
Raid Vastian Griegh's Transport.
missions.summary_en: Side job: raid Vastian Griegh's transport. The name is a callback -- AquaNox 1 has a mission 4N2 of the same name.

takes.text: Your restaurateur was right. Griegh will pass by here, at the Nav Point I marked for you!
Let's wait here for our clients....
Hey, hey... here they come. And look at that - a Tiburon! I just marked that rotten ship with a Nav Point!
Hard work before play time! First you'll have to take out Griegh's bodyguards!
I'm docking now. Cover me, Drake!
I'm in! Railguns ready to fire!
Shit! The captain says the Freighter's empty. Nothing! Nada! Damn - hang on while I check the hold!
God dammit - this Freighter's emptier than a politician's head! I'm pissed off!
Freaking job! Really burns my butt! I'm gonna blow that thing to pieces for good!
Fox, pull yourself together! Stay calm!
Forget it - I hate that goddamn Tiburon. And I hate being let down!
Off we go, William. This part of the ocean's about to evaporate! Yee-haa!
Woo-hoo! That's what life's about, man! Just great!!!
That's that, folks.... We've got no hope without the Eerie!
Stoney, you're not very smart! Aw... come on back!

missions.briefing_en:
Task:
Queen Strega is launching a major attack with her Order Mercenaries.
Defend the Harvester.
Destroy the enemy.

Tactical Hint:
The Order Mercenaries are well equipped!
missions.hint_en:
Tip:
Warning: Elite pilots!
Being clever counts!
Watch out for bombs!
missions.summary_en: Queen Strega launches a major attack with her Order Mercenaries. Defend the Harvester and intercept the bombs.

takes.text: The Harvester must not be crippled! Do whatever you can - we can't hang around here all day!
Damn! There's too many of those bastards! I haven't got enough hands or weapons!
Where's the Eerie? Nat, we need the TechBomber now!
Okay... I'll head out.... I don't see any other way!
Nataniel - long time no see! And now, such a quick farewell! Because you're as good as dead!
Okay, Strega, I've been waiting for this for a long time. Our last dance... for my son!
You're not going to escape me! I've always been stronger than you!
I'm hit, Crimson.... I... won't make it! Take them all home, boy!
Nat? ...Naaaat?! Shit! Shit!!! Not now! Nat, answer me!
Farewell, Nat - and so much for family! There's no heaven for people like us, and hell is gonna spit you out! Off we go, Order Mercenaries. Time to travel!
A direct hit! Armor at 75%! Protect the Harvester!
The Harvester can't take all this fire much longer! Give it all you've got!
The Harvester's gonna be finished any minute! Faster now - she can't take much more!
Okay, crew - come back on the double! The Harvester's hurt bad! We need to shove off!
Crimson! Astern of the Harvester... I've located two more of those swimming bombs. You take care of them! We can handle things here!

missions.briefing_en:
Task:
Queen Strega is waiting to duel you.
Take revenge for Nat!
missions.summary_en: Duel against Queen Strega, who is waiting for the player. Revenge for Nat.

takes.text: Nephew, when you were little you pissed in your diapers. Now, you might as well put your tail between your legs and do it again!
You have no chance. The Order Mercenaries have allies stronger than you can possibly imagine!
You're never gonna hold the Angel's Tears in your hands! I've taken your Angelina... and that crazy uncle of yours!
Stay cool, man... don't let her provoke you. I've located the bitch and marked her with a Nav Point!
Crimson - think of Angelina! Think of Nat, and about our objective! You must not die! Show that witch!
Take that bitch out, man! This is your moment! Get her, Drake!!!
Well, look who's here... my wee little nephew. Another minute or two, and I'll have rid this planet of the last Drake!
William, I said I'd always be there for you! I'm sorry but we had to make you believe I was dead...!
That little bitch is alive?! Well then allow me to unite you both in an unholy conflagration!
Don't get pushy! I'll chop both of you to pieces!
I'm going to keep your burned-out skull as a trophy! The last grin you'll ever know....
...They're gonna come! You can't stop them! Your children will drown in their own blood...
It's over, Crimson! I'll salvage the key!
Holy sharkshit, William! I can't believe it - we're alive! Fuzzy! Animal! Stoney! We're alive!!! William... I'll meet you on the Harvester....
Hey, shrimp... that wasn't bad! You'll die slowly for it though!
You little bastard! How dare you fire on me! I'll kill you with my bare hands if I have to!
Bastard! I'm gonna blow you back to the stone age!
You're gonna regret that, you bastard!
Crabshit coward!
You dead yet? Or is it gonna take a bit more to end the Drake family line?
Now I'm going to bury your sorry Drake butt for good!
You lousy little shit!
Nat - he was chained to the legend, but I don't care anymore. I'm breaking my oath to make you suffer torment! Now let's kill that she-devil!

missions.briefing_en:
Task:
The hidden entrance to the Stone Sepulchre is near.
Find the entrance and open it.

Tactical Hint:
Take along McGregor's torpedo!
missions.summary_en: Finale. Find and open the hidden entrance to the Stone Sepulchre; McGregor's torpedo is required. The shipped goal text still reads 'NOT AVAILABLE' -- an unfinished localisation string in the released game.

takes.text: We're picking up something here, William. ...Some kind of interference. Check the Nav Point!
That... what is that? A gate...? Some kind of huge gate...!
We won't get in there. Even the torpedo key is no use now.
Shit! We've got the damn key - where's the damn keyhole? William, take a look around!
William, head for that new Nav Point. I'm picking up interference again....
What... those holes, there! What are they? William - have a closer look. Could just be erosion....
Shit - look at that! Each rock has a hole in it at the same height! That's not natural!!!
Take a closer look at the rock at the far end. Is that some kind of marking...?
Stoney's right! I've marked it with a Nav Point! Move in!
Woooo... I can't believe it! An angel - can you see it?! Can you see that freaking angel....??? ...Yeah!
William... I can feel it.... We've almost made it! I'm so frightened!
Hm.... The gate key! Fire it through those holes! William! Oh, my god....
Hey, Drake - it's not gonna happen from that angle, man!
